name: Sample User
comfort: shoes I can walk 2 miles in

read.signature: Classic tailoring with Elegant Chic polish: cream silk, black wide-leg lines, and camel structure, with room for a purposeful color accent.
bullets: The cream silk blouse, black wide-leg trousers, and tailored blazer felt like you at your coffee chat; keep that clean, polished formula in rotation.
Your comfort rules are specific: skip the black loafers that pinch, and choose walkable shoes with no pointed toe and a heel no higher than two inches.
For a quick gym walk, the half-zip is enough; don’t put the bulky black puffer over your spin clothes.
Your closet supports a warm-neutral foundation, while your stated love of hot pink makes a deliberate pop of color worth keeping in the mix.
Next, try the blouse-and-trouser combination under the camel trench for a polished, recruiting-ready variation.

strategy.text: Keep pairing the cream silk blouse with the black wide-leg trousers; you said this polished combination felt like yourself.
Layer the camel trench over that loved blouse-and-trouser outfit for a fresh recruiting-ready version.
Look for a cropped, tailored deep-teal jacket to bring the board’s distinctive shorter-jacket shape and your rich-season color into the closet.
When you need a polished shoe, try a rounded-toe, walkable flat or low block-heel shoe in a warm brown leather, honoring your comfort rules.
Stop building outfits around the black leather loafers that pinch; they do not meet your walking comfort rule.
Keep the black puffer for genuinely cold-weather needs, not quick gym walks where your grey half-zip already feels like enough.

goal.title: Warm-toned city classic
goal.look: A cream silk blouse tucked into black high-rise wide-leg trousers, under a cropped tailored deep-teal jacket; layer the camel trench over it. Finish with cognac leather ankle boots with a block heel, a structured chocolate leather bag, and small gold earrings. The cropped jacket and trench bring the board’s polished city structure, with deep teal as the rich color accent.

read.blend_why: Your one positive outfit reaction strongly supports the Classic foundation and Elegant Chic finish: tailored pieces, silk, and a polished result that felt like you. Romantic remains a light accent in your stated blend, but there is not yet enough feedback to know how much softness you want in everyday outfits.

pending_qs.q: You’ve turned down the black leggings, but I don’t yet know what missed for you. Was it the leggings themselves or that particular outfit?
Where would you most like me to dress you next?

feedback.label: Puffer over spin clothes
feedback.note: Too bulky for a 5-minute walk to the gym; a half-zip is enough.

feedback.label: Cream blouse, black trousers, blazer
feedback.note: Felt like myself at the coffee chat.

evidence: You chose “Polished” for how friends describe your style, which points directly to Classic.
Your tomorrow outfit choice—silk blouse, tailored trousers, and delicate gold—strongly reflects Elegant Chic.
Your closet has classic foundations: a black tailored blazer, camel trench, crisp light blue oxford, and tailored trousers.
You loved the cream blouse, black trousers, and blazer outfit because it felt like you at a coffee chat.

Your style words—polished, minimal, and sporty-chic—reinforce the clean, refined direction. The “soft and graceful” quiz answer adds a gentle note, but is less consistent with the rest of your evidence.
pieces_to_add: A deep burgundy silk or satin blouse for a rich, graceful accent
A warm-charcoal or dark-olive tailored blazer to expand your polished layering options
Espresso or dark-olive straight-leg tailored trousers with a soft waistband
A simple gold or bronze pendant necklace for one refined point of shine

inspo.summary: A mix of polished city looks: dark tailored layers and simple tops with relaxed denim or short silhouettes, finished with practical statement footwear and minimal accessories.

aesthetic.summary: Polished city classic with a preppy, off-duty edge: crisp layers, clean tailoring and practical flats, with a playful red or softly romantic detail. The through-line is structure and polish; the softer floral look feels like an occasional romantic variation rather than the everyday uniform.

archetypes.name: Classic
archetypes.why: The trench, neat jacket, crisp shirt, straight trousers and structured bags give the board its timeless, composed foundation.

archetypes.name: Elegant Chic
archetypes.why: Long, clean lines and refined neutral layering—especially the camel trench over dark tailoring—bring a sleek city finish.

archetypes.name: Romantic
archetypes.why: The wrap silhouette, floral midi and soft cardigan add one fluid, feminine counterpoint to the sharper looks.

styling_moves: Layer a crisp shirt or fine knit under a clean, slightly cropped jacket.
Use the trench as a long, polished top layer over a simple tonal outfit.
Balance a shorter skirt with a neat jacket and understated accessories.
Define the waist on a wrap dress, then soften the line with a fine cardigan.
Keep accessories edited: one structured bag and a small gold detail.
For your coloring, keep the board's color-blocking but use warm cream, deep navy and a rich red rather than icy white o…
aesthetic.season_note: Keep the silhouettes and warm neutrals, but translate the board's bright red into tomato or burgundy, and its pale floral look into cream with deeper rose, aubergine or forest accents. Choose warm cream rather than stark white and favor gold or bronze details; keep dusty pink away from the face.
aesthetic.user_note: This board is very much in your Classic-with-Elegant-Chic lane: polished layers, clean tailoring and practical-looking flats, with just enough playful color to keep it from feeling too serious. I’ll keep that sharp city foundation in rotation and treat the floral wrap look as a softer Romantic option, translated into your richer Deep Autumn palette.
